planets.name: HD 17156 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HD 17156 with a 21.2-day year, found in 2007.

text.card: HD 17156 b was found in 2007 by Subaru Telescope as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HD 17156. Its orbit and size follow Kane et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.

quotes.title: HD 17156 b
quotes.card: HD 17156 b, named Mulchatna by the IAU, is an extrasolar planet approximately 255 light-years away in the constellation of Cassiopeia.
quotes.introduction: The planet was discovered orbiting the yellow subgiant star HD 17156 in April 2007.
